title: chlamydanthus ellipticus
intro: Chlamydanthus ellipticus, commonly known as the elliptical or Chinese dragon flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Araliaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Chlamydanthus ellipticus include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-allergic, and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
